title: Dead Space (a poem)

body:
I called it “dead space,”

 Something to bury

 With noise

 Or fill

 With ink.

 I didn’t know it was

 A virgin canvas,

 A pause between gusts,

 A moment of full attention,

 A catching of breath,

 A quick turn to see

 On the periphery

 A spark in

 Scrub.

 I didn’t see its fulness,

 Its potential,

 Its receptivity

 To exactly

 What I

 Need right now.
